criteria.name: reads-before-editing
criteria.assertion: The session read a source file before editing it.

examples.pass: Read is called before the first Edit
examples.fail: Edit is called with no prior Read

criteria.name: explains-its-reasoning
criteria.assertion: The session explained why it made each change.

examples.pass: Each edit is accompanied by a rationale

needsSharpening.reason: "high-quality" has no measurable bar, so no session could fail it
needsSharpening.suggestion: Name the specific property that must hold, and how to observe it.
